name: sherlock-phones
displayName: Sherlock Phones: mobile app security audit
description: Audit Android app source code for security vulnerabilities in chat. Checks the manifest and network security config, follows exported components, deep links and JS bridges to dangerous code with a code graph, records findings by attacker (other app, link, network, device), re-verifies each one adversarially, and exports Markdown/SARIF reports mapped to the OWASP Mobile Top 10 and MASVS. Requires Java 17+.
